audience: Shopify merchants who manage wholesale and B2B prices with the BSS B2B Solution app

useCases.title: Find the pricing rules for a customer tag
useCases.text: Find the custom pricing rules that apply to customer ids or tags, such as b2b. Open one rule by its id to read its discount.

useCases.title: Find the rules that apply to a product
useCases.text: Search products by text. Then find the custom pricing rules that apply to the matching product ids or tags.

useCases.title: Review wholesale applicants waiting for approval
useCases.text: List applicants with status pending and a submission date range. Read the registration form to check the fields each applicant filled in.

useCases.title: Approve or reject a wholesale applicant
useCases.text: List the pending applicants, then approve or reject them by email. Only accounts in pending status change.

useCases.title: Save or delete a custom pricing rule
useCases.text: Save a custom pricing rule, or delete rules by id. Changes to store prices take effect at once.
